fusions.name: Rolled Tackle
fusions.desc: Curls into a ball and rolls you up to 6 tiles into a target, dealing 14 damage and leaving it [Bruised] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Bristling Curl
fusions.desc: Hunches and flares your scaled back, dealing 3 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles and stripping 10% of their armour for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Arms Over Head
fusions.desc: Tucks your head under your forearms and curls: you gain a barrier that absorbs the next 22 damage for 6 seconds, and your armour rises by 10%.

fusions.name: Layered Brawn
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
